reserveReview.rationale: NUSD is the Synapse nexus-pool LP token and its documented reserve model is a basket of DAI, USDC, and USDT liquidity. The reviewed sources do not publish a current asset-value snapshot or a defensible weight split, so the former 34% / 33% / 33% allocation is represented as one identified basket.
